title: TEREX CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Terex Corporation filed an 8-K announcing that its board of directors has set June 25, 2026, as the date for the company's 2026 annual meeting of stockholders. This date represents a change of more than 30 days from the anniversary of the 2025 annual meeting, triggering disclosure requirements under SEC Rule 14a-5(f). The deadline for stockholder proposals to be included in proxy materials is April 23, 2026.
key_points: Board of directors set June 25, 2026, as the date for the 2026 annual meeting of stockholders
Date change exceeds 30 days from anniversary of 2025 annual meeting, triggering Rule 14a-5(f) disclosure requirements
Stockholder proposals under Rule 14a-8 must be received by April 23, 2026, to be included in proxy materials
Deadline for Rule 14a-19 (proxy solicitation) and Bylaw-based proposals remains unchanged
Filing signed by Scott J. Posner, Senior Vice President, Secretary and General Counsel

It does not contain material non-public information regarding Terex's financial condition, operations, or strategic direction. Of no relevance to macro or market structure analysis.
